input: Get a second dental opinion on the crown quote

gold.taskTitle: Get a second opinion on your crown quote
gold.taskDescription: Research and visit a second dentist to evaluate whether the crown treatment plan and quoted price from the first dentist are reasonable.

questions.title: Which tooth or teeth need the crown?
questions.description: Identify the specific tooth number or location to give context for the second dentist.

questions.title: What is the exact dollar amount quoted?
questions.description: Know the precise quote figure so the second dentist can make a direct comparison.

questions.title: What type of crown was recommended by the first dentist?
questions.description: Determine whether it is porcelain, ceramic, metal, or a porcelain-fused-to-metal crown.

questions.title: Do you have dental insurance covering this procedure?
questions.description: Understand insurance status to assess out-of-pocket cost and network constraints.

questions.title: Do you have X-rays or records from the first dentist?
questions.description: Confirm whether transferable records are available to share with the second dentist.

questions.title: Is there a deadline or urgency driving this decision?
questions.description: Find out if there is a time-sensitive reason such as pain, a treatment hold, or a quote expiry.

questions.title: Do you already have a second dentist in mind?
questions.description: Establish whether a new dentist needs to be found or an appointment simply needs to be booked.
